'''Juran Reb''' was a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the husband of [[Audila]].

==Biography==
Juran and [[Audila]] first met [[Risha Drayen|Risha]] when the latter, at the age of fourteen, rushed to explore [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They became both friends and business partners and stayed in touch with her after Risha went separate ways from them. In [[3643 BBY]], Audila was kidnapped by a group of [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] while Juran was at work. The kidnappers threatened to kill Audila if Risha didn't meet them at the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] [[Abandoned Czerka Mining Complex|mining complex]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Juran made a desperate holocall to an old friend, and Risha accepted her role in the events. She came to the exchange point as expected, but the lead [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] refused to release Audila, saying that his "liege" wanted no witnesses. It was then that Risha's partner, [[Voidhound]], arrived and defeated the assassin leader. Audila was very angry at Risha, blaming the incident on her and asking for reasons. Risha refused to explain that the assassin was after her because of her royal status on [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]]. As a result, Audila threatened to sever ties with her. Risha asked Audila to trust her and then gave Audila and Juran some [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to get off Tatooine. Audila accepted them but reminded Risha that she'd want an answer to the events someday.

Juran and Audila eventually settled on [[Byllura]], running a little frontier mercantile exchange. She sent a short note to Risha, letting her know that they were okay.
